query: SELECT metadata,user_id,grants,deleting,revision,totp_key_id FROM password_item_entities WHERE team_id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT deleting AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_user membership JOIN "User" profile ON profile.id=membership.user_id WHERE membership.team_id=$1 AND membership.user_id=$3 AND NOT profile."isAgent") AND (user_id=$3 OR grants @> $4 OR grants @> $5 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_user WHERE team_id=$1 AND user_id=$3 AND team_role IN ('owner','admin'))) AND lower(btrim(metadata->>'name')) IN (SELECT lower(btrim(name)) FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS name) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 500
